findings.label: Silent persist on load depends on null-on-missing read
findings.detail: Load-time reconciliation removes + saves any Slides item whose cache entry is null. Correct only because SlidePresentationService.GetByIdAsync returns null (never throws) for a missing row; a throwing read would propagate to the outer catch and skip reconciliation entirely (fail-safe, no partial removal). Verified by existing GetByIdAsync_UnknownId_ReturnsNull / DeleteAsync_UnknownId_IsNoOp_DoesNotThrow. No change required; noting the coupling.

findings.label: Inlined index scan in delete handler duplicates helper intent
findings.detail: OnDeletePresentationRequested re-implements the 'Slides && id matches' index collection inline rather than reusing the tested helper (which keys off an existing-set, not a single target id). A FindItemsLinkingPresentation(order, id) helper would make both removal sites test-covered and symmetrical. Style/symmetry only; behavior matches the tested count predicate.
